title: Randomized exponential-time class
statement: The class consists of all languages $L$ of Boolean strings for which there are natural numbers $c,e$ and a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet satisfying the following conditions: on every input $x$, its runtime is at most $c(|x|^e+1)$; on inputs in $L$, its acceptance probability can be made at least $2/3-\varepsilon$ for every rational $\varepsilon>0$ by choosing a suitable number of random choice bits; and on inputs outside $L$, every halted run outputs `[false]`.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of Boolean strings
There exists a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
Runtime is at most $c(|x|^e+1)$ on every input
Yes instances have acceptance probability at least $2/3-\varepsilon$ for each rational $\varepsilon>0$, for some choice-bit length
Every halted run on a no instance outputs `[false]`
